facts.hand-sword: A hand coming out of a cloud on the left holds a sword straight upright.
facts.crown-tip: A gold crown hangs on the upward-pointing tip of the sword.
facts.branches: From the crown, an olive branch hangs to the left and palm leaves to the right.
facts.drops: Six yellow drops fall on both sides of the sword.
facts.mountains: Rugged gray mountains can be seen below.
facts.glow: Pale rays of light spread around the hand.

glosses.hand-sword: A clear thought that cuts through what is hazy.
glosses.branches: A decision that carries both peace (olive) and victory (palm).

reversedGloss.blocked: The thoughts are not sorted out, so the decision is put off.
reversedGloss.excess: Sharpness goes too far and becomes aggressive words.

misdescriptions.wrong: A hand comes out of a cloud on the right.
There is blood on the sword.
The tip of the sword points downward.
